title: BA4/11/2023 of RAKESH MISHRA ALIAS RAKESH KUMAR ALIAS PAPPU MISHRA Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Fourth Bail Application No.11 of 2023
Rakesh Mushra alias Rakesh Kumar alias Pappu Mishra
 ........Applicant

Present:-
Mr. Mani Kumar, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. V.S. Rawat, Brief Holder for the State.
Mr. Lalit Kumar, Advocate for the informant.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
 Applicant Rakesh Mushra alias Rakesh Kumar
alias Pappu Mishra is in judicial custody in FIR No.363 of
2021 dated 15.06.2021, under Sections 302, 504, 506
IPC, Police Station Rudrapur, District Udham Singh
Nagar. He has sought his release on bail. This is the
fourth bail application of the applicant. His first bail
application was treated as short term bail application and
the applicant was granted short term bail for three weeks,
which was extended subsequently on the ground that the
applicant is suffering with Cardiomyopathy; second bail
application was also treated as short term bail and the
applicant was further granted short term bail on the
ground of health and the third bail application was also
treated as short term bail application.

2
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and
perused the record.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant would
submit that the applicant's heart is not functional fully;
he is unwell; he was sent to Dr. Susheela Tiwari
Government Hospital, Haldwani, District Nainital for
treatment. From where, he was referred to AIIMS, New
Delhi; the applicant is under treatment; his condition is
not well.
4. On 27.09.2023, this Court has considered
the fourth bail application and noted as follows:-
" One of the grounds that has been
taken is that the applicant is unwell. His
heart is not functioning to its fullest
capacity. In fact, it is working at the
strength of 15 to 20 percent. Certain
documents have been referred to,
particularly, page no. 57 which is a
remark forwarded by Sub-Jail, Haldwani
on a diagnosis slip of Dr. Susheela
Tiwari, Government Hospital, Haldwani,
which records that it is a case of severe
LV dysfunction LVEF 15-20%. There are
other prescriptions as well.
Let learned State counsel get
instruction about the health condition
particularly the condition of the heart of
the applicant. If required, he may be
produced before an expert at Dr.
Susheela Tiwari Government Hospital,
Haldwani.
List this matter on 05.10.2023 after
fresh.

3
Meanwhile, In-charge, Sub-Jail,
Haldwani is requested to ensure that
adequate medical facility is provided to
the applicant."
5. Today, a report was received from
Superintendent of Sub-Jail, Haldwani, District Nainital
dated 03.10.2023. Along with it, a report of Medical
Officer, Sub-Jail, Haldwani dated 03.10.2023 has been
forwarded. It records as follows:
"He is a follow up case of dilated cardio myopathy,
type-2 DM and severe left ventriculr dysfunction with left
ventricular ejection fraction of (15-20%).
Patient was referred for above mention condition to
Base Hospital, Haldwani from where he was referred to Dr.
Shusheela Tiwari Government Hospital, Haldwani, from
where he was refer to AIIMS, Rishikesh. Where he was
treated by consultant from AIIMS, Rishikesh. He was again
sent to Dr. Shusheela Tiwari Government Hospital,
Haldwani for above medical condition. The cardiac
department of Dr. Dhusheela Tiwari Government Hospital,
Haldwani referred him to AIIMS, New Delhi. Since then, he
is continuing his treatment from AIIMS, New Delhi.
He was again sent to Dr. Shusheela Tiwari
Government Hospital, Haldwani for lower back ache and
vertigo where he was treated by the doctors of orthopaedic
department. He was diagnosed for lumber spondylitis with
L3-L4 & L5 annular fissure and also diagnosed fro mild
splenomegaly.
He is continuing his medication as prescribed by
AIIMS, New Delhi for his cardiac condition and also
continuing his medication as prescribed by the doctors of
Dr. Shusheela Tiwari Government Hospital for lower back

4
ache and splenomegaly. At present the patient condition is
stable."
6. Learned counsel for the informant would
submit that the applicant is well. After granted short
term bail, he was roaming here and there.
7. Learned State counsel would submit that the
applicant is un-well.
8. Merits are different. When the matter is
considered at merits, the Court goes on the chances of
an accused of fleeing from justice, the chances of
tampering with the evidences, etc. The applicant in the
instant case is not seeking bail on merits. What is being
argued is that the applicant is unwell. Earlier on the
three occasions, the applicant was granted short term
bails, which were extended also.
9. It is the case of the applicant that he is a
heart patient. His heart is not fully functional. The
report from the Sub-Jail Haldwani, District Nainital
confirmed it. The report of Medical Officer, Sub-Jail
Haldwani, District Nainital reveals that the applicant is,
"He is a follow up case of dilated cardio myopathy,
type-2 DM and severe left ventriculr dysfunction
with left ventricular ejection fraction of (15-20%)".

5
The report also suggests that the applicant has been
referred to Dr. Susheela Tiwari Government Hospital,
Haldwani, District Nainital for examination and
thereafter, referred to AIIMS, New Delhi. He is still
under treatment.
10. Having considered the medical grounds of the
applicant, this Court is of the view that the applicant
deserves to be enlarged on bail.
11. The bail application is allowed.
12. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his
executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable
sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the
court concerned.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 06.10.2023
Sanjay
